purpose: State that circumstances prevent continuing an action or state.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
We cannot wait any longer. Let us leave first.
The deadline is close, so we cannot take it easy.
restrictions: Usually means one cannot afford to keep doing something.
mistake: Do not interpret it only as physical inability.
